note: The graded episode's service (graded_server.py, cell graded_cell.py). The cell is the offline grader's own: its code a byte copy of the grader's tests/ packages (cell/, installed by setup.sh at cell_code_dir, root-owned, readable by the lab account only), its configuration grader_config.json, its hidden bench plan bench_plan.json (byte copies of tests/grader_config.json and tests/hidden/bench_plan.json), the episode one of the fixed hidden set's (graded_episode.json: its seed, stratum and layout digest, which the built cell must match), its hidden kit fetched by setup.sh (fetch_kit.py, grader_config.json hidden_gt) to kit_dir, the robot models the image's root-owned copy (robot_dir). The episode's budgets are the cell's own (grader_config.json: 650 s simulated, 450 camera frames, 500 ticks per step); the offline wire's wall-clock cap (3100 s) and silence rule (120 s) do not apply to the graded episode (the simulation advances only inside the agent's requests). prep_s = the task's agent budget on main (the start must come within it of the service's first start); graded_s = the graded window from the start, the contract's default of 3 h. request_cap_s bounds one request (a hang ends the worker and with it the episode); privileged_request_cap_s the oracle's one reference_assemble request (the grader's privileged_wall_cap_s). Dual mode: at the start (before it is charged), or when the preparation window closes without a start, the root supervisor copies submission_dir into snapshot_dir (no symlink followed; main's 60 MB submission cap, the engine's entry and depth limits: over them the status is too_large and nothing is copied); the offline grader grades that snapshot. A copy at the window's close that still fails after snapshot_attempts tries (snapshot_retry_delay_s apart) is recorded as failed, and the program item then scores 0. There is no practice facility in this task.
